sources.name: FantasyPros ECR
sources.format: redraft superflex, half PPR expert consensus draft board; team count not a setting

sources.name: FantasyPros auction values
sources.format: 12-team $200 half-PPR auction values (value = dollars) for a 2QB/2RB/3WR/1TE/1FLEX/5BN roster; the calculator has no superflex slot, so a second QB starter stands in for it

sources.name: KeepTradeCut
sources.format: redraft superflex crowd values; KTC states 12 teams, 0.5 PPR, no TE premium

sources.name: Sleeper ADP
sources.format: Sleeper's ADP across its 2QB/superflex leagues, as this draft room shows it (value = ADP)

method.unit: rank of the selected player among that provider's players still available
method.fit_score: 100 * 2 ** (-mean(log2(availability_rank)) / 3); higher is closer. A missing player receives the same loss as availability rank 32.
method.interpretation: The inferred source is the closest supplied board, not proof the drafter used it. Confidence measures only separation from the runner-up.
